test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Correct the underlined part of the sentence.

This mango is __bitterer.__
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The underlined part of the sentence, "**bitterer**," is incorrect because it uses the comparative form inappropriately.
 
• The sentence implies a simple description of the mango's taste, not a comparison between two or more mangoes.
 
• For a simple description, the base form of the adjective should be used.
 
• Therefore, the correct form of the adjective in this context is "**bitter**."

Therefore, the correct answer is **4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"This mango is **bitter**."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1) most bitter** – This is the superlative form, indicating the highest degree of bitterness among three or more items. It's not suitable for describing a single mango.
 
• **2) more bitter** – This is the comparative form, used to compare the bitterness of two items. The sentence doesn't suggest a comparison.
 
• **3) bitterest** – This is another superlative form, similar to "most bitter," and is also inappropriate for describing a single item without comparison.
